baselineDisplay.title: Dream (Langston Hughes)
baselineDisplay.text:
Hold fast to dreams,
For if dreams die
Life is a broken-winged bird
That cannot fly.
Hold fast to dreams,
For when dreams go
Life is a barren field
Frozen with snow.
